purpose: Propose (NOT ratify) the conditions under which fitting a real model would even be considered. No number here is project law; nothing here authorises fitting.
explicit_non_authorisation: This gate is a DRAFT. Fitting requires separate explicit future authorization + human ratification.
no_hardcoded_count: Deliberately does NOT hard-code 15 (or any count) as law; 15 forward records / 5 sessions is an EXISTING documented promotion condition (DETECTOR_V0_4_PROMOTION_GATE.md:9), referenced not re-legislated.
considerations: number of independent genuine prospective campaigns
class balance (activated vs no-trade vs invalidated)
chronological split viability (enough folds without leakage)
stability of results under explicit cost assumptions
requires_before_fitting: pre-registered feature set + model class + metric
